summary: The clips of “ey ordenador” from the `tigregotico-ey_ordenador-es` test set, placed between seconds of Spanish speech, followed by 7 hours of read speech, music, household and outdoor sounds and speech in other languages with no wake word. A detector streams every recording and is scored on the wake words it caught and on how often per hour it woke with no wake word.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py from `tigregotico-ey_ordenador-es` at TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-ey_ordenador@9a9a9e01 (400 of 587 clips with the phrase) and the negatives of `es-ES`. The negatives hold 4 h of read speech, 1 h of music, 1 h of household and outdoor sounds, 1 h of speech in other languages: 7 hours in all.
